name: passwordless-sudo
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: grants the cocoa administrator unrestricted passwordless sudo through a sudoers drop-in.
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

install -d -m 0755 /etc/sudoers.d
printf '%s\n' 'cocoaadm ALL=(ALL:ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/00-cocoa-nopasswd
chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/00-cocoa-nopasswd
if command -v visudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/00-cocoa-nopasswd >/dev/null
fi
